'''Syvris''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was a favorite haunt of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. Many of the moon's residents were smugglers, who lived and worked at a [[Syvris shadowport|shadowport]] located in its largest crater.

==History==
A [[Battle of the Syvris system|battle]] occurred in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of Syvris during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

Syvris was located on the border between [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-controlled space. It was [[Raid on Syvris shadowport|subjugated]] by Imperial forces shortly before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].
